conclusion.reason: Finish every frozen unit; retain all failures

limits.energy: simulation separate; no Energy measurements in H1 tables

limits.reproduction: Actual locked clean reproduction and scientific report execution remain a separate post-cohort gate
limits.strongest_models: H3 mandatory practical assets/adapters and numeric transfer design not evaluated
limits.track_c: external references excluded from local measured tables
